texts: Added support for Crimson God Sinclair in Clash Arena.
Added Identities and E.G.O Corrosions categories to Shadow Guesser.
Adjusted the number randomization of the generator in Clash Arena. Many statuses should be more likely to grant conditionals now.
Updated the Universal Gifts page with the new gifts.
Fixed an issue in Clash Arena where reconnecting to a room that has draft points disabled while it's your turn to draft could softlock the game due to being unable to draft.
Fixed an issue where the skill replacement UI elements would not properly display for MD Plans using the spec build recommendation mode.
Made some minor layout adjustments to some pages.
